scope: Current Web UI and node-view UI; new modules require an explicit owner before integration
deferred: Node-canvas collapse height/port/edge coordinated geometry: integrate after the node reconstruction contract is frozen; direct manipulation remains immediate

motion-runtime.behavior: Shared timeline ownership, preference, segmentation or modal lifecycle; no business timing

anchored-surface.behavior: enterSurface + exitSurface; close becomes inert immediately; latest intent owns completion

paired-modal.behavior: attachModalLifecycle + closeModalSurface; scrim and panel share teardown; resource work stays independent

state-controls-and-view.behavior: Semantic control state layers, native details disclosure, route fade; pointer-coupled editors/canvas/drag stay 1:1

existing-explicit-owner.behavior: Boot screen uses its opacity transition; drawer uses paired CSS transitions with native reversal and pointer/focus lifecycle

node-public-interaction.behavior: Shared semantic controls, parameter-region fade and category disclosure; canvas geometry is explicitly deferred

node-model-support.behavior: UI model/history functions have no interactive surface; callers own motion

non-interactive-support.behavior: No interactive surface: resource/data/storage/shape utilities; callers own visible transitions
